rationale: Putting the reserve to work, deliberately and only partly. The morning held 5.44 USDT back for the 64,100 daily-EMA20 line. Price stopped at 64,172.6 - 72.6 points short - and then rallied 816 points off that low without ever filling the order. That is the second time this week that waiting for a perfect fill has meant watching the move from the sidelines, and the reserve is now just 2.7% of a 200 USDT book, small enough that the optionality is worth less than the participation. So 3.00 of the 5.44 goes in here at 64,590.8 and 2.44 stays for a genuine retest under 64,200. The structural case is intact: the daily EMA20 at 64,104.86 held on closes for a seventh day and was defended with a 480-point recovery hour, price is above all four 4H EMAs, and the ETF streak reads 170.1, 211.5, 244.4 on three accelerating days. What argues against sizing this bigger is real - the 4H MACD histogram has decayed on four straight readings from +100.90 to +43.24, the long/short account ratio is live at 1.24 against 1.18 this morning so retail is more crowded long, 65,000 has now rejected five times, and macro tightened on all three axes with Brent +3.68%, DXY 99.962 and the 10-year at 4.672%. No futures leg: spot is almost exactly halfway between a tested 64,172.6 floor and a five-times-rejected ceiling, with the heaviest liquidation wall on the board 209 points overhead. That is the worst place on the chart to pay for leverage in either direction.

message.text: BTC 64,590.8 at 12:50 COT, +0.06% on the morning mark of 64,549.9 but that hides an 816-point round trip: low 64,172.6 on the 13:00Z hour, high 64,989.1 on 15:00Z, back to the middle. Book after this add: 0.00306325 BTC around an average of 64,056, roughly 2.44 USDT of cash, futures flat. Three things to settle at 19:30. ONE, what the 06 Aug Farside row printed - it was still a full line of dashes at 12:47 COT and it settles after the US close, so you get the first real read. A deceleration off 244.4M is the fastest way for the bullish tilt to become untenable. TWO, whether the 4H MACD histogram is still positive. The sequence is +100.90, +79.52, +56.10, +43.24 across four readings against highs spanning 10.9 points; if it crosses zero while price is still mid-box, the range resolves down and the reduce line should come to meet price rather than wait at 64,150. THREE, whether 64,172.6 held as a higher low. It is the whole basis for moving the reduce line up 50 points, and the overnight gap is where an untested floor gets tested. If price is anywhere near 64,150 at your run, set the resting stop - the downside is thin under 64,500 and the 64,200 pocket has already been partly paid.

lesson.pattern: A reserve aimed at a precise level is a position you do not own, and the market prices in the last 100 points
lesson.insight: Twice this week cash has been held back for an exact line and twice the line was approached and not filled - 64,125 at midnight, then 64,100 this morning against a 64,172.6 low that missed by 72.6 points and rallied 816 points from there. The pattern is that a level derived from a moving average is where buyers are ALREADY waiting, so the queue fills above it, not at it. The operational fix is not to abandon level-based entries but to split them: put the first tranche in at the level plus roughly a third of the recent ATR and leave the rest at the line itself. On today's numbers, with a 1H ATR of 256, that would have meant a bid at 64,185 rather than 64,100, and it would have filled. The second half of the lesson is about position size - a reserve that has shrunk to under 3% of equity has almost no optionality left to protect, so the calculus flips from waiting to participating.
